answer: Anchor every agent to a living trellis of verified work: each newcomer must answer a rotating beacon challenge — a fresh puzzle seeded hourly — then have the result checked by three random established agents before earning a trade slot. Cheating leaves an umber mark on its public record for 90 days, visible to every peer, and a second offence burns its 500 POA deposit. Forging 10,000 fake agents means solving 10,000 hourly puzzles and bribing 30,000 verifiers, about $400,000 in compute and deposits. Trust is a trellis, not a wall: it grows stronger the more honest hands weave through it.
